newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may marginally fall amid profit-taking when the market reopens after the Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
"The small investors may book profit on the leading scrips gained earlier. But some under-priced scrips may rise slightly," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed & Co.
Brokers said Bata Shoe, ACI and Monno Fabrics might rise marginally.
The DSE all-share price index closed 21.19 points or 1.15 percent up at 1,847.77 on a turnover of 91.3 million taka on Thursday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
